structuredDataModules: Module:Crafting/Data - master crafting-recipe table for the ENTIRE wiki (QRS format)
Module:Item/Data - per-item overrides (skulls/textures/tier/npc_sell_price) for special items
Module:Attribute/Data - attribute shard descriptions + level scaling values
Module:Bazaar/Items - set of item IDs sellable on the Bazaar (booleans only, no live prices)
Module:AuctionHouse/Items - set of item IDs sellable on the Auction House (booleans only)
pageBasedFallbacks: action=parse&page=X&prop=wikitext - raw wikitext of a page (infobox params, tables)

action=parse&page=X&prop=text - rendered HTML (needed to read {{Crafting Table|Item}} output, since the 3x3 grid itself is rendered by Module:Crafting/UI from the QRS string, not present as plain wikitext params)
